scope: Native PNG16/ICC16 sample-library reference selection, explicit legacy reinspection, verified opaque RGB16 PNG output and matching destination/UI routes. Precision integration, not new handbook feature acceptance.

static_verification.runtime: UNRUN: no product imports, codecs, tests, build, compiler, typecheck or inference executed

integration_map.sample: sample_library_source -> genuine PNG16/TIFF16 decode -> working_rgb -> native_thumbnail or immutable reference ColorInput; duplicate controller reinspection requires retained hash and catalogue CAS
integration_map.export: export._write_verified_rgb16 -> png16_export -> pinned imagecodecs native RGB16 -> frozen resolve_target / atomic commit -> native pixel/ICC readback
integration_map.ui: exportModel reconciliation -> App and metadata controls -> existing native transport -> server and export_destination_runtime actual container -> queue receipts

remaining_limitations: Nonopaque source alpha, HDR/APNG/unsupported PNG colour signals and gray ICC remain explicit refusals; no clipping or flattening.
RGB16 delivery retains ICC-only metadata policy; source EXIF/GPS passthrough is not implemented.
Failed postcommit readback retains and names the file, but structured unverified committed-output receipts are not yet implemented; frozen retry refuses overwrite.
Unsupported high-bit library items display a labelled placeholder. Eligible legacy rows require explicit same-original reimport; existing references are never rewritten.
Ordinary RGB8 originals are not promoted as genuine 16-bit masters. Wide-gamut conversion is not lossless gamut mapping.
All codec, numerical, performance, UI, preset/project replay, photographic and application acceptance remains UNRUN. Per-target visual spill batch review and broader handbook gaps remain unfinished.
